PYPL.case: In re PayPal Branded Checkout Securities Litigation, N.D. Cal. No. 3:26-cv-01589
PYPL.note: Live 10(b)/20(a) class action over branded-checkout growth disclosure and the 2027 targets; Darcy (2026-02-24) consolidated with Norfolk County RS (2026-04-02) on 2026-05-21, institutional lead plaintiffs appointed, class period Feb 2024–Feb 2026. No MTD ruling yet, unspecified damages, no accrual disclosed. Five derivative suits (Goncalves, LR Trust, Stan, Lovoi, Haliburton) ride on the same facts. The earlier NNA action (In re PayPal Holdings Securities Litigation) was dismissed WITH prejudice 2026-03-31 and is on appeal to the 3rd Cir.; its derivative suits are stayed. Downgraded by hand from the automated `existential`: the credibility trigger was the phrase "Civil Investigative Demand", but the CIDs are FTC and CFPB conduct matters (merchant onboarding, Reg E, PayPal Credit) plus German FCO and UK FCA competition proceedings — no restatement, no material weakness, and no SEC or DOJ matter anywhere in the filing. The claim is about growth disclosure, not about the books.
